user.title: Set up Quran Player
user.description: Choose one or more existing Home Assistant media players that can play a public HTTPS MP3 URL. Quran Player creates one virtual device and controls these outputs through Home Assistant.

data_description.media_players: Select Chromecast speakers, Cast groups, or other media players that accept remote MP3 playback.
data_description.default_reciter: The initial reciter. It can be changed later from the Quran Player device.
data_description.default_volume: Applied to a target before its first Quran playback. Later volume changes are remembered per target.

error.no_targets: Select at least one media player.
error.invalid_target: Every output must be a media_player entity.
error.recursive_target: Quran Player cannot control its own virtual media player.

abort.already_configured: Quran Player is already configured. Use Configure to edit its outputs.

init.title: Configure Quran Player
init.description: Add, remove, or reorder playback outputs and change startup defaults. Saving reloads the integration once; saved player selections remain when valid.

data_description.media_players: The order determines which real player supplies aggregate position and duration information.
data_description.default_reciter: Used when there is no valid saved reciter selection.
data_description.default_volume: Used for targets that do not yet have a remembered Quran Player volume.

error.no_targets: Select at least one media player.
error.invalid_target: Every output must be a media_player entity.
error.recursive_target: Quran Player cannot control its own virtual media player.

invalid_target.message: The selected playback target is no longer configured.

stop_failed.message: Unable to stop playback on: {targets}. Try stopping those players directly.

mute_failed.message: Unable to change mute state on: {targets}.

invalid_reciter.message: The selected reciter is not in the approved catalog.

invalid_surah.message: The selected surah is unavailable for this reciter.

invalid_repeat.message: Repeat must be Off, One, or All.

invalid_duration.message: Playback duration must be between 0 and 720 minutes.

invalid_media_id.message: The requested media item is not in the approved Quran Player catalog.
